Author: J. Uma Devi
Bench: J. Uma Devi
 The Hon'Ble Ms.JUSTICE J. Uma Devi
 Criminal Petition No.335 of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 r/w.457 Cr.P.C. seeking to release the vehicle i.e.,
Mahindra Verito Car bearing registration No.AP07-AT1654 which was involved in Cr.No186 of 2019, dated 16.12.2019, of Prathipadu Police Station, Guntur Urban, Guntur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of Indian Penal Code, under Section 24(1) of Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 and under Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Prathipadu Police Station, Guntur Urban, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner states that the petitioner is the bread winner of his family, and he ekes out his likelihood by giving the seized vehicle on hire to third parties.
By stating so, he request the court to order for release of the vehicle in favour of the petitioner.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor opposed the petition.
The petitioner is Accused No.1 in the above mentioned crime.
As per the prosecution case, petitioner/A1 and another were found carrying banned tobacco products in the subject vehicle.
The investigation has not been completed so far.
The petitioner is owner of the seized vehicle.

After hearing the learned counsel for the petitioner, this court is of the opinion that keeping the vehicle in the custody of the police will serve no purpose, and on the other hand, its value gets diminished day by day as there is every likelihood of vehicle getting damaged due to its exposure to hot sun rays, rains and other climatic conditions.
2 JUD,J Crl.P.335 of 2020 Accordingly, this criminal petition is disposed of.

Interim custody of the vehicle i.e., Mahindra Verito Car bearing registration No.AP07-AT1654 be granted to the petitioner/A1, subject to the condition that the petitioner proves the ownership of the said vehicle and executes a personal bond for a sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees two lakh only) together with one surety in a like sum to the satisfaction of the VI Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Guntur District and also on further conditions, viz.,
(i) the petitioner shall not tamper with the vehicle in any manner and shall maintain the vehicle as it stands as on today;

(iii) the custody is only interim custody; consequently the petitioner shall not put the vehicle to any use other than his personal use, and (iv) the petitioner shall not sell or otherwise dispose of or alienate the vehicle until disposal of the main case in the connected crime.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed in consequence.
